# ui::ContextMenuItem

Header: `winui/render/ContextMenuHost.hpp`.

One entry of a system context menu shown through [ContextMenuHost::show()](context-menu-host.md#show): a text item or a separator. The menu is flat, with no submenus, icons or check marks.

Example: 
```cpp
const std::vector<ui::ContextMenuItem> items{
    {"receive"},
    {"recipe"},
    ui::ContextMenuItem::separator(),
    {"Add to dictionary"},
    {"Paste", /*enabled=*/false},
};
```

## text

```cpp
std::string text
```

UTF-8 label; ignored for a separator.

## enabled

```cpp
bool enabled = true
```

A disabled item shows grayed and can't be picked.

## is_separator

```cpp
bool is_separator = false
```

A divider line instead of an item.

## separator

```cpp
static ContextMenuItem separator()
```

A separator entry (disabled, no text).
